findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:2 lacks any verificationEvidence assertion in the smoke: the intent requires that canonicalJson with undefined-valued keys omits them from output, but packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-digest-extract-smoke.ts contains no check that exercises undefined-valued keys. All 28 evidence records share the same generic note ('smoke asserts byte-identical pinned digests + order-independence + digestText!=digestCanonicalJson') which does not demonstrate coverage of this specific behaviour.

findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:3 and CHK-001:edge:4 lack any verificationEvidence assertion in the smoke: the intents require (a) digestCanonicalJson on empty object {} returns deterministic sha256 of '{}' and (b) digestText on empty string returns sha256 of the empty string. The smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-digest-extract-smoke.ts contains no check exercising either of these empty-input cases. Both edge cases are independently falsifiable (a corrupted digestCanonicalJson that errors on {} would not be caught).

findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:1 lacks any verificationEvidence assertion in the smoke: the intent requires that canonicalJson with a 100-level deeply nested structure does not crash and produces deterministic output, providing a stress test on recursive normalizeJson. The smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-digest-extract-smoke.ts contains no check that generates or tests a deeply nested structure beyond the 2-level PINNED_OBJ. A stack-overflow bug in normalizeJson would go undetected.

findings.desc: CHK-002:edge:1 lacks a verificationEvidence assertion: the intent requires confirming that 'Digestable type is no longer defined in decision-doc-promotion.ts (it comes from core/digest.ts now)'. The smoke check 'no-local-defs' at packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-digest-extract-smoke.ts only checks for absence of function definitions (canonicalJson, digestCanonicalJson, digestText, normalizeJson) and absence of createHash, but does not scan for 'type Digestable' or 'Digestable'. The type duplication check specified in the intent is absent. (Note: inspection of decision-doc-promotion.ts confirms Digestable is in fact absent, but no smoke assertion binds this evidence to the intent.)
